title: Final Accreditation Rule Leaves Higher Ed Concerns Largely Unaddressed
summary_en: Developed through the department's Accreditation, Innovation, and Modernization negotiated rulemaking process earlier this year, the regulations establish more than 20 new requirements for accreditors evaluating colleges and universities.
title_cn: Final Accreditation Rule Leaves Higher Ed Concerns Largely Unaddressed

title: Higher Ed Groups Raise Concerns About Research and Education Provisions in Defense Bill
summary_en: The National Defense Authorization Act sets defense policy and authorizes military spending, but it also regularly includes provisions that affect colleges and universities.
title_cn: Higher Ed Groups Raise Concerns About Research and Education Provisions in Defense Bill
